--Create master key encryption by password , this is credential
CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = 'Swadhin@15'

--scoped credential
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL cred_ansh
WITH 
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

--create external data source for silver and Gold layer
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_silver
WITH(
        LOCATION = 'https://anshadfstorage.blob.core.windows.net/bronze/',
        CREDENTIAL = cred_ansh
)

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_gold
WITH(
        LOCATION = 'https://anshadfstorage.blob.core.windows.net/gold/',
        CREDENTIAL = cred_ansh
)

--External file format
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT format_parquet
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)



-- CREATE External Table using CETAS
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.extsales
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'Extsales',
    DATA_SOURCE = source_gold,
    FILE_FORMAT = format_parquet
) AS
SELECT * FROM gold.products

SELECT * FROM gold.products;
